definitions.explanation: Transferring an unused balance, amount, or entitlement to the next period. Commonly used in accounting, finance, and for things like unused vacation days or data allowances.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有給|ゆうきゅう}{休暇|きゅうか}→有給休暇：06996_yuukyuukyuuka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{繰|く}り{越|こ}し⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Is it possible to carry over unused paid leave?

examples.japanese: ⟦{先月|せんげつ}→先月：00751_sengetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦{容量|ようりょう}→容量：04887_youryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{繰|く}り{越|こ}し⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Last month's data allowance was carried over.

examples.japanese: {繰|く}り{越|こ}し⟦{残高|ざんだか}→残高：05422_zandaka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}んで→組む：02050_kumu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please check the carried-over balance before setting up the budget.

notes:
USAGE:
{繰|く}り{越|こ}し is commonly encountered in accounting ({繰越金|くりこしきん}, carryover funds), mobile phone plans (data rollover), and workplace vacation policies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {繰|く}り{越|こ}し⟦{残高|ざんだか}→残高：05422_zandaka⟧ (carryover balance)
- {繰|く}り{越|こ}し{金|きん} (carried-over funds)
- {繰|く}り{越|こ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧ (carryover is possible)
- ⟦{翌月|よくげつ}→翌月：21206_yokugetsu⟧{繰|く}り{越|こ}し (rollover to next month)

RELATED VERB:
{繰|く}り⟦{越|こ}す→越す：02282_kosu⟧ (to carry forward) is the verb form. {繰|く}り⟦{越|こ}される→越す：02282_kosu⟧ is the passive form commonly used with balances and amounts.
